signInNotice.notice: Starting {date}, the Forge asks you to sign in. It's still free. Your saved work comes with you.

one.title: Two tools. One working life.
one.body: The Forge builds your story and your first stronger resume. The Refinery is your ongoing workspace: tailor that resume to a job, write a cover letter, practice an interview and work through disclosure with t.ROY.

two.title: First, give us something real to work with.
two.body: Bring a resume, even a rough one, or build from your work history with t.ROY. Then tell us what you actually did, what people relied on you for and what you want next. Paid work, training and volunteer work all matter.

tools.c: Tell the story behind the duties

three.title: The work you put in matters.
three.body: Rebuilding your history can be hard. Specific details give t.ROY more to work with and give employers more reasons to take you seriously. Your resume is the foundation for tailored applications and interview practice. This first draft is the start; you keep improving it in the Refinery.

four.title: Tools to compete. A voice in what comes next.
four.body: The Forge is free. We want these tools to help you compete for real opportunities. When you have tried them, please take three minutes to tell us how it went, good or bad. Honest reviews help others find us and help us improve. Reviewing is optional and never changes your access.
